card.name: Inside personal names in author lists
card.fires_on: Partway through a person's name, mostly in citation and author lists, where the next word is likely a first or given name. Also fires on a few unrelated linking words.

modes.label: Inside names in citations
modes.description: Within a surname or given name in a reference or author list, just before another name part.
modes.example: Reichelt Russell E, Trew<<in>> Dennis (2006 Australian

modes.label: Name followed by a comma in speech
modes.description: A first name or address word just before a direct-speech continuation.
modes.example: ("Reading with dimmed light is bad for the eyes.") - "Frank<<,>> kun jij het licht dimmen

modes.label: Scattered linking words
modes.description: Short function words in running text with no name nearby.
modes.example: The resources on this site should not<< be>> used as a substitute for professional medical care

card.writes: It pushes the model toward common male first names such as Brian, Sean, Eric and Kevin.
card.plain: It fires inside people's names in reference lists, where a first name such as Brian or Sean may come next.
evidence: Reichelt Russell E, Trew<<in>> Dennis (2006 Australian
